candidate.user_submission: Di pikin never get any convulsion and e no dey convulse now. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Di pikin fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 18 months old. Di pikin get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count di pikin breaths for one minute. I give bronchodilator trial finish. Chest no sink inside when di pikin dey breathe. Di pikin calm. Di cough don last for 3 days. After bronchodilator, I count breaths for one minute. After bronchodilator, chest no sink inside. After bronchodilator, di pikin still calm. After bronchodilator, di respiratory rate na 42. Pulse oximeter no dey. Di pikin no dey get cough with wheeze wey dey come back. Di respiratory rate na 45. No stridor when di pikin calm. Di pikin dey wheeze.
